description: This source file defines functions and constants for generating build commands and handling build system integrations in the Chromium project's GN build tool. It includes code for writing ninja files, IDE project files, and handling various build configurations and post-processing steps.

classes.name: TargetWriteInfo
classes.description: Struct to hold information for writing ninja rules per toolchain, including synchronization primitives and output mappings.

methods.name: BackgroundDoWrite
methods.description: Worker thread function to generate ninja rules for a target and update shared data structures.

methods.name: ItemResolvedAndGeneratedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked after a target is resolved and generated, scheduling background writing.

methods.name: FindTargetThatGeneratesFile
methods.description: Finds the build target that generates a specific output file.

methods.name: PrintInvalidGeneratedInput
methods.description: Prints an error message for files that are inputs but not generated by dependencies.

methods.name: CheckForInvalidGeneratedInputs
methods.description: Checks for generated inputs that are not produced by any target dependencies.

methods.name: RunIdeWriter
methods.description: Runs the appropriate IDE project generator based on the specified IDE name.

methods.name: RunRustProjectWriter
methods.description: Generates a rust-project.json file for Rust ecosystem tools.

methods.name: RunNinjaPostProcessTools
methods.description: Runs post-processing tools on the generated ninja files.

methods.name: WriteIgnoreFile
methods.description: Creates a .gitignore file in the build directory to ignore build artifacts.

methods.name: RunGen
methods.description: Main function to handle 'gn gen' command, generating ninja files and IDE projects.
